DisplayName.value: Kitsune Loads ~ Cats of 7 Days: Summer

Description.value: Cats of 7 Days, the summer special: Kevin the tabby takes it easy through the long hot days while the zombies cook in the sun. 12 widescreen scenes (heatwave, fishing dock, motel pool, watermelon, sunflowers, hammock nap, ice chest, summer storm, desert minibike, fireflies, campfire, blood moon over the lake) rotate at random every time the loading screen appears. Mutually exclusive with the other KitsuneLoads packs ~ install one or the other.
